newsitem.title: UK: Slow start for new French rail line in UK.
newsitem.headline: Slow start for new French rail line in UK.

text.p: Trains on Britain's South Eastern lines got off to a slow start on Monday when equipment problems delayed services on the first day under new French ownership.

However, signalling breakdowns at the busy London Bridge station did not hit plans by Connex, part of the Generale des Eaux transport and utility group, for a media event to celebrate the first day of its 15-year franchise contract to run the line.
A company spokesman said a ceremonial train carrying company officials and guests used another route.
Some Monday morning commuters were hit by delays of up to 45 minutes on journeys from the company's main Kent and southeast London catchment areas.
And, to add to the embarrassment, delays were compounded by an angry passenger getting off one train and onto the electrified tracks, forcing Connex to disconnect the power.
